skill.name: flux-2-klein
skill.description: Generate images through the RunComfy CLI using Flux 2 Klein 4B or 9B, with guidance for prompts, generation settings, and reference images.
skill.summary: Guide fast image concepting and final refinement with hosted Flux 2 Klein models.
skill.author: prime-skills

security_audit.summary: All 57 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, expected CLI operations, documented service URLs, API abbreviations, and credential storage. No evidence found of malicious intent, credential theft, or audit-directed prompt injection. One semantic concern remains: shell examples omit prompt escaping while asserting injection safety; the external CLI implementation was not available for verification.

remediation.issue: Prompt placeholders appear inside single-quoted shell arguments, but the safety statement overlooks quoting performed by the invoking shell.
remediation.suggestion: Use JSON serialization and argument arrays with shell execution disabled. If shell commands remain, document safe argument escaping and test apostrophes and metacharacters.

semantic_findings.title: Shell Quoting Safety Is Incorrectly Assumed
semantic_findings.description: Examples place <user prompt> inside single-quoted shell JSON without escaping guidance. Literal substitution of an apostrophe can terminate the shell argument before CLI processing. The statement "No shell injection surface from prompt content" overlooks this boundary and can encourage unsafe command construction.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples and absolute safety claim are explicit. Exploitation depends on literal prompt substitution; no executable interpolation implementation was supplied.

content.value_statement: Image concepting requires repeated adjustments to subjects, composition, and lighting. This skill guides Flux 2 Klein generation through RunComfy with variant selection and focused prompting.
actual_capabilities: Provides RunComfy CLI examples for Flux 2 Klein 4B and 9B image generation.
Guides variant selection and generation steps for concept exploration and final refinement.
Explains subject-first prompts with specific composition, lighting, style, and camera details.
Documents image dimensions, aspect ratio constraints, and prompt length guidance.
Describes reference-image styling and conditional edits, with field names delegated to the provider documentation.
Documents asynchronous requests, request identifiers, local output downloads, cancellation, and common exit codes.
limitations: Requires the external RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, and network access; it does not provide local inference.
Documents an approximately 2K resolution ceiling, a 16:9 aspect ratio cap, and a roughly 512-token prompt limit.
Reference workflows require checking current API field names and support at most four references according to the skill.
Text rendering can be imperfect; latency and output quality claims were not independently tested during this audit.

use_cases.description: Compare composition and lighting variations with 4B before refining a selected direction with 9B.

use_cases.title: Create Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate product scene concepts with controlled framing, camera details, and studio lighting.

use_cases.title: Develop Consistent Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Use aligned reference images and explicit preservation instructions to guide a consistent visual style across asset concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B to generate a ceramic mug on a white table with soft window light. Save to [output directory].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Lighting Directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B at 4 steps for three product concepts of [product]. Keep framing consistent and vary lighting. Confirm submissions first.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Selected Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 9B at 25 steps and 1024 by 1024 pixels. Refine [selected concept] with precise materials and lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Guide a Brand Variation
prompt_templates.prompt: Check current reference-image fields for Flux 2 Klein 9B. Use [approved references], preserve composition and lighting, and change [detail]. Confirm external submission first.

output: Prompt: A matte ceramic mug on a white table, soft window light from the left, neutral background, product photography.

output_examples.input: Plan a reference-guided bottle label change while preserving the original scene.
output: Proposed model: Flux 2 Klein 9B at 25 steps.
Reference instructions: Preserve the bottle silhouette, composition, lighting, table, and shadow. Change the label to blue with white AURA lettering.
Required check: Confirm the current reference-image field name and approval to send the reference to RunComfy.
Review requirement: Inspect generated lettering for accuracy.

best_practices: Start with the subject, then specify composition, style, lighting, and camera details using concise language.
Explore with 4B and refine with 9B; keep reference images visually consistent and verify current API fields.
Confirm external submissions and output locations. Serialize JSON and pass CLI arguments without shell interpolation to protect arbitrary prompt text.
anti_patterns: Requesting native 4K output or extreme aspect ratios beyond the documented model limits.
Combining conflicting visual instructions, inconsistent references, or excessively long prompts.
Inserting unescaped prompt text into shell examples or sending confidential references without approval.

faq.question: What must I install before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with a RunComfy account. The skill provides instructions, not a bundled model runtime.

faq.question: How do 4B and 9B differ?
faq.answer: The skill recommends 4B for fast concept exploration and 9B for final detail. Actual performance depends on the hosted service.

faq.question: Can I generate images offline?
faq.answer: No. This workflow sends generation requests to the RunComfy Model API and downloads generated outputs.

faq.question: Can I provide reference images?
faq.answer: The skill describes support for up to four references. Check the model API documentation for current field names before submitting.

faq.question: Does installing this skill include generation credits?
faq.answer: No credits are included in the skill. Review RunComfy pricing and account requirements before submitting generation requests.

faq.question: How should I protect prompts and credentials?
faq.answer: Approve external submissions, protect the RunComfy token, and avoid shell interpolation of prompts. Escape arguments safely when using shell commands.
